checks.expectation: Guarded test database setup succeeds; PostgreSQL migration probe and Redis PONG both succeed; absent services fail.

F-R01 through F-R04 assert input normalization/rejection, zero adapter calls for invalid inputs, and no unsafe reflected values. Both operations retain independently validated scope on every invalid timeout type/key format while omitting malformed scope/bounds.
F-C01 through F-C05 assert complete catalog facts, empty/missing/unsupported distinctions, bindings and all retained uniqueness/reference failures.
F-P01 through F-P10 assert completed inclusive intervals, eligibility precedence, retained closure, historical affiliation, all nine count meanings/types and no invented rows.

F-D01 through F-D05 assert default/custom strict readiness deadlines, normalization and portions sharing one budget, terminal timeout and real blocked-worker cancellation. Production Runtime accepts 4294968000 and 10000000000000 ms budgets in both operations with immediate success/error, retains correlation and cancels huge-budget blocked workers on caller exit.
F-E01 through F-E03 assert every error category/retry rule and sentinel absence in every inspected caller-visible value, including provenance and hostile diagnostic inputs.
F-O01 through F-O03 repeat every source/case twice offline, enforce five leagues/two seasons and all 17 scenario links, prove reference bijections detect same-name merges/swapped edges.

argv:
set -eu
fixture_git_shim=$(mktemp -d /tmp/task016-no-git.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$fixture_git_shim/git"; rmdir "$fixture_git_shim"' EXIT
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 99\n' > "$fixture_git_shim/git"
chmod +x "$fixture_git_shim/git"
PATH="$fixture_git_shim:$PATH" elixir test/provider_contract_offline.exs fixture-preservation
checks.expectation: With a failing Git shim first on PATH, assert fixed independently captured SHA-256 fingerprints of deterministic Erlang serialization for all four expanded fixture terms and exactly 217 entries per file. No Git/history prerequisite or current-fixture-derived expected fingerprint.
Every pure suite executes together without application/service startup, including nonempty selection, failure exit status and deterministic matrix assertions.
F-I01 asserts exact catalog state/read equality after all eight failures and zero provider calls during each local read; no retries or fallback.

AST dependency/shape and changed-production-path assertions enforce FR-014, no Repo/web/transport dependencies, league parity and no writes/scoring/new endpoint. Existing Statistics invariants remain asserted; Mix ignores only the five exact data/bootstrap files and its other AST is unchanged.
